initial.reason: Monomer1 is bisphenol-A diacrylate (two acrylate C=C groups) — rigid, aromatic backbone to raise Tg toward 150°C and two vinyl-type reactive sites for high crosslink density (increasing Er). Monomer2 is para-bis(2-mercaptoethyl)benzene (two thiol groups, dithiol) — provides at least two thiol reactive sites (CCS-type thiol fragments) for thiol–ene/thiol–acrylate coupling with monomer1. The combination enables efficient thiol–ene/acrylate crosslinking, high network rigidity (high Tg) and substantial crosslink density (high Er ≈ 75). Both SMILES are synthesizable and chemically compatible.
